description: Cost, token and request history comes from the LiteLLM Postgres spend log, so it is not limited by Prometheus retention. Model breakdowns group by provider and requested model. Costs are LiteLLM's estimates: for anthropic (Claude subscription) and opencode_go (Go allowance) they are list-price equivalents, not money billed. Traffic status, fallbacks and latency still use Prometheus and are not affected by the dashboard filters.

panels.description: Estimated cost in the selected time range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum(spend) AS value FROM public.litellm_grafana_spend WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND provider IN (${provider:sqlstring}) AND model IN (${model:sqlstring}) AND api_key_alias IN (${key:sqlstring})

panels.title: Total cost

panels.description: Estimated cost in the selected time range, per provider.

targets.rawSql: SELECT provider AS metric, sum(spend) AS value FROM public.litellm_grafana_spend WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND provider IN (${provider:sqlstring}) AND model IN (${model:sqlstring}) AND api_key_alias IN (${key:sqlstring}) GROUP BY provider

panels.title: Cost by provider

panels.description: LLM requests in the selected time range (MCP tool calls left out).

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM public.litellm_grafana_spend WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND provider IN (${provider:sqlstring}) AND model IN (${model:sqlstring}) AND api_key_alias IN (${key:sqlstring})

panels.title: Requests

panels.description: Input + output tokens in the selected time range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum(total_tokens) AS value FROM public.litellm_grafana_spend WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND provider IN (${provider:sqlstring}) AND model IN (${model:sqlstring}) AND api_key_alias IN (${key:sqlstring})

panels.title: Tokens

panels.description: Estimated cost per interval, stacked by provider.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(time, '1h'), sum(spend) AS value, provider AS metric FROM public.litellm_grafana_spend WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND provider IN (${provider:sqlstring}) AND model IN (${model:sqlstring}) AND api_key_alias IN (${key:sqlstring}) GROUP BY 1, provider ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Cost over time by provider

panels.description: Share of the estimated cost in the selected time range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT provider AS metric, sum(spend) AS value FROM public.litellm_grafana_spend WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND provider IN (${provider:sqlstring}) AND model IN (${model:sqlstring}) AND api_key_alias IN (${key:sqlstring}) GROUP BY provider

panels.title: Cost share by provider

panels.description: Estimated cost per interval, stacked by provider and requested model.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(time, '1h'), sum(spend) AS value, provider || ' / ' || COALESCE(NULLIF(requested_model, ''), model) AS metric FROM public.litellm_grafana_spend WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND provider IN (${provider:sqlstring}) AND model IN (${model:sqlstring}) AND api_key_alias IN (${key:sqlstring}) GROUP BY 1, provider, COALESCE(NULLIF(requested_model, ''), model) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Cost over time by model

panels.description: Per provider, requested model and upstream model in the selected time range. Cost per request = cost / requests.

targets.rawSql: SELECT provider AS "Provider", COALESCE(NULLIF(requested_model, ''), model) AS "Requested model", model AS "Upstream model", sum(spend) AS "Cost", count(*) AS "Requests", sum(spend) / count(*) AS "Cost / request", sum(prompt_tokens) AS "Input tokens", sum(completion_tokens) AS "Output tokens" FROM public.litellm_grafana_spend WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND provider IN (${provider:sqlstring}) AND model IN (${model:sqlstring}) AND api_key_alias IN (${key:sqlstring}) GROUP BY provider, COALESCE(NULLIF(requested_model, ''), model), model ORDER BY "Cost" DESC

panels.title: Models

panels.description: Estimated cost in the selected time range, per LiteLLM virtual key (None = master key).

targets.rawSql: SELECT api_key_alias AS metric, sum(spend) AS value FROM public.litellm_grafana_spend WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND provider IN (${provider:sqlstring}) AND model IN (${model:sqlstring}) AND api_key_alias IN (${key:sqlstring}) GROUP BY api_key_alias ORDER BY value DESC

panels.title: Cost by API key

panels.description: Estimated cost in the selected time range, per provider and model name the client asked for (opus, sonnet, go-*, opr/*...).

targets.rawSql: SELECT provider || ' / ' || COALESCE(NULLIF(requested_model, ''), model) AS metric, sum(spend) AS value FROM public.litellm_grafana_spend WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND provider IN (${provider:sqlstring}) AND model IN (${model:sqlstring}) AND api_key_alias IN (${key:sqlstring}) GROUP BY provider, COALESCE(NULLIF(requested_model, ''), model) ORDER BY value DESC

panels.title: Cost by requested model

panels.description: Input and output tokens per interval, by provider.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(time, '1h'), sum(prompt_tokens) AS value, provider || ' input' AS metric FROM public.litellm_grafana_spend WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND provider IN (${provider:sqlstring}) AND model IN (${model:sqlstring}) AND api_key_alias IN (${key:sqlstring}) GROUP BY 1, provider ORDER BY 1

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(time, '1h'), sum(completion_tokens) AS value, provider || ' output' AS metric FROM public.litellm_grafana_spend WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND provider IN (${provider:sqlstring}) AND model IN (${model:sqlstring}) AND api_key_alias IN (${key:sqlstring}) GROUP BY 1, provider ORDER BY 1
